localHeading: Garage door care for Shaker Heights homes
localIntro: Shaker Heights has an established residential housing stock where the garage door should suit both the opening and the home. We can diagnose an older door before recommending a visible replacement or opener upgrade.
localIssues: On a door that shakes or makes a grinding sound, we examine hinges, rollers, track clearance, and spring balance. Quiet operation depends on those parts as well as the opener.
localAdvice: For a new door, we can discuss material, window placement, and finish after measuring the garage. Any exterior changes should also be checked against applicable local review or permit requirements.
